channel.description: The day's vulnerability report reveals a critical concentration of high-severity flaws within the Microsoft ecosystem, featuring numerous remote code execution and privilege escalation vulnerabilities across Windows desktop components, Azure cloud services, SQL Server, and enterprise suites like SharePoint and Exchange. Parallel threats target web infrastructure and data layers, with actively exploited remote code execution in GitLab, injection flaws in WordPress plugins, and memory corruption issues compromising major database engines and middleware. Operational technology and edge networks face significant risk as well, with authentication bypasses and command injection vulnerabilities identified in IoT platforms, industrial control devices, and foundational network services such as DNS and DHCP.
